pipeline.license_origin: MAIA proprietary (in-licensed from research origins; cemiplimab supplied by Regeneron under clinical supply agreement)

indications.indication: Advanced/metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), 3rd line, post-checkpoint resistant
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 pivotal, randomized study of ateganosine + cemiplimab vs chemotherapy (docetaxel, vinorelbine, gemcitabine) as 3rd-line treatment in advanced/metastatic NSCLC

indications.indication: Advanced NSCLC (2nd/3rd line, sequential with checkpoint inhibitor)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 evaluation of ateganosine sequenced with cemiplimab in advanced NSCLC; expanded in July 2025 to focus on 3rd-line checkpoint-resistant patients
